name: Beatriz Barbosa
summary: Data-driven Senior Product Manager with 7 years of experience scaling fintech and e-commerce platforms in Latin America. Proven track record of leveraging user research and analytics to optimize transaction conversion rates and drive digital wallet adoption. Adept at leading cross-functional squads to deliver high-impact features aligned with core business metrics.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
experience.description: Led the core credit card acquisition team, managing a cross-functional squad of 12 engineers, designers, and data analysts. Redesigned the onboarding funnel using Figma for user flows and tracked performance via SQL, boosting user conversion rates by 14% and reducing drop-offs. Collaborated with risk teams to integrate dynamic credit scoring models, acquiring over 1.2M active cardholders in 18 months.

experience.title: Product Manager
experience.description: Managed the personal loans product line, conducting qualitative User Research and implementing iterative A/B testing. Created operational dashboards in Tableau and Power BI to monitor portfolio health and repayment rates. Improved digital loan checkout completion by 18% and integrated credit bureau APIs to lower approval decision times to under 30 seconds.

experience.title: Product Manager
experience.description: Owned checkout and native payment experiences for RappiPay in Brazil, managing backlog prioritization and sprint planning in Jira. Introduced localized payment methods that increased successful transactions by 6.2%. Reduced average transaction latency by 300ms through database query optimizations and API redesigns.

experience.title: Associate Product Manager
experience.description: Collaborated on checkout flow optimization for Mercado Pago, writing SQL queries to discover friction points in the conversion funnel. Implemented targeted user surveys that informed micro-interaction updates, reducing mobile cart abandonment by 5%. Managed cross-functional delivery milestones for 2 agile software development teams.
